body_markdown:
At[Logitech G PLAY 2026](https://www.logitechg.com/campaigns/logitechg-play) , Logitech G marked 10 years of PRO with the introduction of four new products: the PRO X3 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Headset, PRO X2 RAPID Wired Gaming Keyboard, PRO X CONTROL Gaming Mouse Pad, and PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE Gaming Mouse. Together, they reflect a decade of design and engineering innovation shaped in close collaboration with pro players whose feedback helped guide decisions across the lineup.


“The best PRO gear is designed with players, not just for them,” says Thadeous Cooper, Head of PRO Series Marketing at Logitech G. “We bring esports athletes into our labs, meet them at events like DreamHack, and study how they move, react, and perform under pressure. That insight shapes every design decision, from form, feel, and weight balance to acoustics, click response, and control, so we can create products that reflect how pros actually play, not how we assume they play.”


This year’s lineup builds on that legacy with four products designed for the demands of modern competitive play.


**The New PRO Series Lineup**


**The PRO X3 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Headset**


[PRO X3 LIGHTSPEED](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/pro-x3-lightspeed) is built for clarity, starting with communication. In esports, callouts need to be understood instantly, and its upgraded 48 kHz/16-bit microphone delivers a major leap in voice quality, helping players sound more natural, detailed, and clear when every second matters. Its 50 mm PRO-G Graphene drivers reveal subtle in-game cues with crisp detail, while a customizable 10-band parametric EQ, memory-foam comfort earpads and perforated headband, and up to 70 hours of battery life make it ready for long sessions under pressure.


**The PRO X2 RAPID Wired Gaming Keyboard**


[PRO X2 RAPID](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/pro-x2-rapid) is built for speed with precise feel. Its enhanced magnetic Hall-effect analog switches deliver the smooth, solid keystrokes elite players demand, combining ultra-responsive input with the key stroke feel pro players demand. Rapid Trigger enables faster resets, sharper movement, and lower latency in the moments that decide rounds. Players can fine-tune actuation from 0.1 mm to 4 mm in 0.05 mm increments, while the onboard OLED display gives direct access to settings like 8 kHz key scan and USB report rate, actuation points, Rapid Trigger, and KEY PRIORITY (SOCD), making it easy to adjust feel and performance on the fly.


**The PRO X CONTROL Gaming Mouse Pad**


[PRO X CONTROL](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/pro-x-control-gaming-mousepad) is Logitech G’s first PRO mouse pad, shaped through years of testing with competitive players to get the feel exactly right. Its precisely-knit cloth surface delivers consistent friction in every direction for steady, predictable aim across flicks and micro-adjustments, and subsurface edge stitching keeps the edges from fraying without irritating your forearm. A 6 mm SlimFlex foam base keeps it planted under pressure, while its large 400 x 460 mm size gives players room to move freely, making it a foundational addition to the PRO Series lineup.


**The PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE Gaming Mouse**


[PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/pro-x3-superstrike-mouse) pushes competitive mouse performance forward with HITS, Logitech G’s[Haptic Inductive Trigger System](https://www.logitechg.com/discover/technology/hits) , a faster, fully tunable click system with 10 actuation levels, 5 rapid trigger reset options, and 6 haptic feedback settings. Testing shows that HITS improves click latency by up to 30 ms versus traditional mechanical or optical microswitches. Paired with the NxLOGI chipset and upgraded HERO 2 sensor, it delivers up to 48,000 DPI, 930 IPS, 8 kHz report rate wired or wireless, 135 hours of battery life, all within a lightweight 59 g design (61 g in EMEA) with refined weight balance.


**Bringing the Lineup Together**


[G HUB](http://logitechg.com/software/ghub) , Logitech G’s customization software, gives players a single place to fine-tune and personalize their setup. From EQ and microphone settings on the headset to actuation points, Rapid Trigger, and KEY PRIORITY on the keyboard, G HUB helps shape each device around individual play styles. On the PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE, that includes haptics and click configuration, allowing players to adjust actuation, rapid trigger reset, and feedback options to dial in a preferred click feel. The result is a more connected system, where every part of the setup can be tuned with intention.


**The Work Starts Again**


What ties this lineup together is not just performance, but process. The PRO Series is shaped through constant dialogue between athletes, engineers, lab testing, and competition-floor reality.


And that is why the work never really ends. Each launch is not a finish line. It is a reset. New tests begin. New feedback comes in. Another detail gets refined. In the PRO Series, the pursuit of perfection is not a promise. It is a cycle, and it is already starting again.


The new PRO Series lineup shows what happens when pro insight, engineering rigor, and the science of play become the foundation for every design decision. Designed with Pros. Engineered to win.
